_comment: Was WARD, which is a different keyword entirely — ward is 'pay {r} to prevent', a cost the defender may decline, not a flat shield. 'Prevent the next N damage' is a one-shot replacement (CR 6.4). The activation restriction ('only if your hero has been dealt damage this turn') is a real gate and is kept. The gate then read the wrong direction: the `damage` turn-marker is recorded against the player who DEALT the damage, so 'only if YOUR HERO HAS BEEN DEALT damage this turn' was answering whether YOU had dealt some. `damage_taken` is the receiving-side marker.
